title: MyceliumRegisterRequest
description: Payload POSTed to {mycelium}/api/mycelium/register by every microservice on ApplicationStarted. Shape derived from vos.Service.Shared.MyceliumClientBase.RegisterAsync.

endpointUrl.description: Base URL Mycelium uses to reach the microservice.

startCommand.description: Token Mycelium uses to restart the service.

logFilePrefix.description: What the service writes its own log file under, so the broker's log routes can find the newest file; never a path.

logDirectory.description: The full path of the folder the service was told to write its log in; absent when it writes to the default folder beside its executable. The broker refuses a folder outside the parent it allows.
